scope.source: authoritative Core20K headword identities and existing KU inventory

operating_principle: coverage before polish; no invented or templated meanings; don't confuse existing KU, generated KU, placeholder with certified KU

tiers.rule: For each of 20000 headwords enumerate existing KU IDs and senses; this is coverage of inventory, not new KU generation
For each word identify at least one valid core sense if actually known and grounded; preserve all distinct existing senses; include extra high value senses only when justified
Add Grammar, Collocation, Contrast, Pronunciation, Usage/Risk only when meaningful; absent fields are allowed
Muse independently reviews generated content with frozen original contexts, followed by targeted correction; production stays blocked until certification

gates.unknown_semantics: HOLD; never create fake generic gloss
gates.new_ids: temporary candidate IDs; never overwrite original KU IDs
gates.review: separate review after broad candidate generation
